title: Climatological model–satellite chlorophyll consistency
query:
Using CMOMS and MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll data for 2011–2022, evaluate the model's climatological seasonal cycle and summer–winter spatial patterns over the supplied northern South China Sea shelf mask (north of 15°N, water depth ≤100 m). Compare thickness-weighted model chlorophyll over the upper 12 m, or the available water column in shallower cells, with the satellite product on common spatial and monthly coverage. Quantify agreement and assess sensitivity to observation coverage, model sampling, and spatial resolution; do not assume satellite retrievals are error-free.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
